summary: Top Wealth Group Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing a change in its independent registered public accounting firm. The audit committee resolved to release Assentsure PAC as auditor effective April 25, 2026, and engaged CHI-LLTC as the new auditor for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. No disagreements or reportable events existed with the former auditor. The filing is a routine auditor change report, not a special situation. There are no deal terms, premium, or strategic transaction involved.
